assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original DubFlow logo + wordmark for a GitHub README.
Primary request: Design a beautiful, distinctive, production-quality identity for DubFlow, a video translation and dubbing pipeline. Create one horizontal lockup: a compact abstract symbol and the exact word "DubFlow" on its right. The symbol should combine a rounded speech bubble / capital D silhouette with three flowing audio-wave lines, suggesting synchronized voices and moving pictures. Minimal, intelligent, memorable; strong negative space, clean geometry, no stock clip art.
Style: crisp flat vector-like raster, refined contemporary humanist/geometric sans-serif wordmark, optical kerning, soft corners. No mockup, no 3D, no drop shadow, no watermark.
Color palette: derive from the existing project's forest-green and mint UI: green #234c41, ink #162c2f, mint #c4e8d6. Use a lighter mid-green for the wordmark so it remains readable against both light and dark GitHub backgrounds. Only the symbol may have a restrained green-to-mint tonal transition.
Composition: wide horizontal canvas about 3:1. The lockup occupies most of the width with only modest transparent breathing space, vertically centered; don't surround a tiny logo with huge empty margins.
Text verbatim: "DubFlow", capital D and F, exactly once. No slogan, no subtitle, no other text.
Background: genuinely transparent, including all outer space; preserve alpha, no painted checkerboard.

assets.edit_prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: edit an existing DubFlow README workflow infographic.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Replace ONLY concrete model labels with generic module labels. Preserve the original layout, dimensions/aspect ratio, forest-green and mint palette, off-white background, all icons, arrows, connectors, numbering, typography style and other text.
Exact text replacements:
- Inside card 01, replace "Qwen ASR + Aligner" with "ASR + Alignment".
- Inside card 02, replace "SAM-Audio Large-TV" with "Audio Separation".
- Inside card 03, replace "Qwen3-TTS" with "TTS".
- Below the vLLM service heading, replace "Qwen3.5-9B" with "LLM".
- Below the LightX2V service heading, replace "TBDub Student" with "Lip-sync Model".
Retain "vLLM" and "LightX2V" because these are serving frameworks, not model choices. Keep the five numbered stages and the original background-audio bypass route unchanged. Do not add any model brand names, parameters or versions. Exact, clean, legible English text with the same polished typography and visual hierarchy. Change nothing else.
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: polished GitHub README architecture / workflow illustration for DubFlow. Create a precise, beautiful, legible technical infographic, landscape about 2:1, generous yet efficient whitespace, warm off-white background #f6f6f0, forest green #234c41, dark ink #162c2f, pale mint #c4e8d6. Flat vector-like finish, fine connectors, tasteful rounded panels, a premium open-source research-project aesthetic. Not a screenshot, not a dashboard, no photos, no neon, no tiny text, no watermark.
Header: left aligned "DubFlow" and below it "Video translation, from speech to screen". Small top-right text "HIGH-LEVEL WORKFLOW".
Main layout: a single horizontal row of FIVE equally sized numbered cards, clear arrows only from left to right. Exactly these titles and short secondary labels:
01 "Understand" / "Words, timing, speakers" / "Qwen ASR + Aligner"
02 "Separate" / "Dialogue + background" / "SAM-Audio Large-TV"
03 "Translate & voice" / "Target-language speech" / "Qwen3-TTS"
04 "Lip-sync" / "Speaker-bound mouth edits"
05 "Compose" / "Paste back, mix, retime"
Add one restrained line icon per card: waveform with timing marks, split waveform, two speech bubbles, face outline with mouth, video timeline. Number badges clear.
Above the first card place a small video-frame icon and the label "Source video", connected DOWN to 01. Above the last card place a matching video-frame icon and the label "Dubbed video", connected UP from 05. No invented faces or sample data needed.
Below card 03, a separate outlined service pill reading "vLLM" with secondary line "Qwen3.5-9B". Connect ONLY this pill to card 03 with a short dashed two-way arrow. Below card 04 a matching service pill "LightX2V" with secondary line "TBDub Student", connected ONLY to 04 by short dashed two-way arrow. Add small legend "Dashed links: independent model services".
Draw one thin MINT background-audio bypass line from card 02, running below the service-pill area, ending in an upward arrow into card 05. Label this line clearly "Original background audio"; it must NOT feed the translation or lip-sync service boxes.
Bottom left a modest note "CLI + Web UI", bottom right "Speaker-aware • Modular • Self-hosted".
All text exact, correct English, readable at README display width. Make typography polished, uniform and not crowded. Logical connections are more important than decoration.
